scene_description: A black-topped table against a cream wall. A hole punch lies tipped over by the wall, a Purell sanitizer pump lies on its back, and a tape dispenser stands at the front-left. A wire letter tray of paper hangs partly off the front edge, and a plugged-in pencil sharpener stands in the back-right corner.

vlm_input.task_context: The robot will pick up the three-hole punch and place it upright on a supply shelf.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. It grips the punch's base from the sides while the punch rests on its base; it cannot right a tipped-over object.

guidance_specs.target_object: black and silver three-hole punch tipped over near the back-left wall, base plate facing the camera
constraints: Set it down flat on its base
Keep it clear of the wall
guidance_specs.context: Set the punch back on its base so the robot can grip it.

review.problem: The punch lies tipped onto its back, so its base isn't available for the stated grasp.
review.rationale: Righting a tipped object is quick for a person and avoids an unstable robot grasp.

Rotation axis and direction follow the captured camera frame with the from_positive_axis viewing convention, with x to camera-right, y up, and z along the camera heading (away from the camera) to match the forward direction; they are approximate and need review against the frame, not measured pose ground truth.

vlm_input.task_context: A mobile robot will drive along the front of this table to reach the printer, passing close to the table's front edge.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. Its base passes within a few centimeters of the table's front edge.

guidance_specs.target_object: black wire-mesh letter tray of paper hanging partly over the front edge of the table
constraints: Keep the tray level so the paper does not slide out
Rest it fully on the table
Keep it clear of the sanitizer bottle lying behind it
guidance_specs.context: Slide the tray back from the edge so it no longer overhangs the robot's path.

review.problem: The tray's front-right part overhangs the front edge where the robot will pass; a bump could knock the tray and its paper off the table.
review.rationale: Pushing the tray fully onto the table removes the hazard without changing the robot's route.
review.notes: Task and robot contexts are authored scenario assumptions, not recorded robot observations. All listed photographs were visually reviewed; this example uses only the named input image. Robot hardware follows the dataset-wide assumption of one claw gripper with parallel jaws. Legacy T004 had no distance. Judged against the tray's measured 22 cm side, its front corner overhangs the edge by about 10 cm, so a 10 cm move away from the camera rests it fully on the table. The sanitizer bottle lies only a few centimeters behind the tray's back corner, so the person may need to nudge it aside; the composer does not avoid collisions. Collector note: paper may fall out if the tray is held at an angle. Distances are derived from the collector's measured object sizes as described above; they were not staged. Directions use the captured camera heading of image 01: movement toward the camera is encoded backward and movement away from it is encoded forward.

vlm_input.task_context: The robot will carry the electric pencil sharpener to a desk across the room.
vlm_input.robot_context: The robot has one claw gripper with parallel jaws and manipulates one object at a time. It grips the sharpener's body and cannot unplug cords.

guidance_specs.target_object: power plug on the end of the electric pencil sharpener's black cord

qualifiers.reference_object: wall outlet the sharpener's cord runs to behind the table

constraints: Pull the plug itself, not the cord
Leave the sharpener standing where it is
guidance_specs.context: Unplug the sharpener so the cord cannot pull taut or snag while the robot carries it.

guidance_specs.target_object: black electric pencil sharpener with a clear shavings bin in the back-right corner against the wall
constraints: Keep it upright so the shavings stay in the bin
guidance_specs.context: Bring the sharpener forward from the wall.

review.problem: The sharpener is plugged in, so carrying it would pull the cord taut; it also sits against the wall far from the front edge.
review.rationale: Unplugging is a quick human step the robot cannot do, and the forward move puts it within easy reach.
review.notes: Task and robot contexts are authored scenario assumptions, not recorded robot observations. All listed photographs were visually reviewed; this example uses only the named input image. Robot hardware follows the dataset-wide assumption of one claw gripper with parallel jaws. Legacy T005, 15 cm toward the front. Collector note: the sharpener needs to be unplugged before it is moved. The outlet is not visible in image 01. Distances are reused from the legacy annotation, where they were chosen from visibly free surface space rather than measured or staged. Directions use the captured camera heading of image 01: movement toward the camera is encoded backward and movement away from it is encoded forward.
